page.overview:
What is Lucretia Black?

Lucretia Prewett (née Black) (1925–1992) was a pure-blood witch from the noble House of Black who was the eldest daughter of Arcturus Black (III) and Melania Macmillan, and the older sister of Orion Black. She married Ignatius Prewett and never had any children.

Lucretia went to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1936 or 1937, where she was Sorted into Slytherin House.

After her graduation, she married Ignatius Prewett, It is unknown if she was close to her relatives by marriage. She was also Sirius and Regulus Black's biological aunt and a second cousin of Arthur Weasley, Molly's husband.

Lucretia died in 1992 and was depicted on the Black Family Tapestry. In 1995, she, along with the rest of the family, was spotted on the tapestry by Harry Potter, Sirius's godson.
